# ElvUI_thingsUI

![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-4.2.1-green)

## Modules
- **Aura Bars** - put a tracked buff or debuff on its own movable bar, anchor it anywhere, or drop it in Groups - Bars or the Bar Setup.
- **Aura Collections** - named aura lists (or Blizzard's own filters like Big Defensives) you edit once and every group follows.
- **Aura Icons** - Aura Bars but icons; restyle, glow, put them in Groups - Icons or right into your Essential/Utility row.
- **Bar Setup** - arrange and stack your bars into one cluster.
- **Buff Bars** - skin and anchor CDM tracked bars, grow up/down, swap font/texture.
- **CDM** - CDM stuff, anchor the Cooldown Manager to Player/Target, icon size, text and glow, aura overlay and pandemic look, racials and on-use trinkets straight into Essential/Utility, and no doubles of things you already show somewhere else.
- **CDM Spell Editor** - one CDM spell or buff at a time: custom icon, glow, aura overlay and swipe, pandemic glow, cooldown and stack text.
- **Charge Bar** - per-spec spell charge tracker, in the CDM cluster or free-floating.
- **Classbar** - per-spec ElvUI classbar where you anchor it.
- **Kick Tracker** - your group's interrupts as bars in M+ etc.
- **Damage Meter** - Details anchored to right chat, or Mini Meter: our own meter on Blizzard's damage data, with split windows, breakdowns and death recaps, anchored to right chat yy you guessed it.
- **Group Icons\Bars\Text** - movable groups of spells, items, auras and Aura Icons\Bars, with visibility rules (combat, solo/party/raid, zone, form, mounted...). Text groups write auras and cooldowns as lines your way: [name] [cd], NO WILD CHARGE [cd].
- **Raid Frame Builder** - put your raid frames in your own order. Drag raid-frame-looking boxes around, sort Tank > DPS > Healer (or however you like it), keep classes together, save. Layouts follow you to every character, export/import works with things for EUI too.
- **Timers** - cast-triggered static-icon timers with auto & manual durations.

## ElvUI QoL
- **Group Frame Anchor** - party/raid frames stay glued to the corner you pick, even near the screen edge.
- Fixes ElvUI's raid frames sometimes parking the first frame of a new column one row too low after a reload or profile swap.

## Grid2
Apply bundled raid-frame profiles (NHT, FHT Icons/Squares) from the Grid2 tab.

## Installer
One-time setup: import profile and plugin things, set UI scale, pick unitframe coloring, move the minimap/auras if you want, choose dmg meter, optional extra action bar layouts, and pick between ElvUI UnitFrames or Grid2. Should pop-up on first time install, re-run it from the Import\Export tab. BigWigs and Blizzard's Cooldown Manager layouts come along. /tui alt is the Character Setup for alts (yeeees, alts): installs, shows what each character uses and loads it, ElvUI and BigWigs going FHT on healer specs by themselves.

# Installation

1. Install with wago app.
2. Install profiles with the wago installer ingame.
3. Run the thingsUI plugin installer.
4. Heal things, or not.

Settings: **/ec** -> **Plugins** -> **thingsUI**

## License

MIT. But if you make it better, I'd like to know nad learn from it.

# Changelog
## 4.2.1
### WoW Forever
- Spell ranks: anything set on one rank (Aura Icons/Bars, Groups, Aura Collections, Timers, Kick Tracker, Spell Editor) counts every rank
- Forever's own racials, potions, healthstones, interrupts, spell lists and Aura Collections, plus a new Drink collection (every drink buff)
- One spec per class: per-spec settings sit on the class, the role rule uses your group role, Delve is gone from places
- Installer: retail CDM layouts stay out, Character Setup gives NHT. A Quick Setup now counts as a finished install
### New: Aura Combo Bars
- A bar of minibars that color in while their auras are up: one per buff or debuff, or a count minibar that fills one step per aura (Withering Bolt: 3 DoTs up = 3 colored)
- Color When: Any / All / None Is Up, or How Many. Auras from the spec's list, an ID or name, or a linked Aura Collection. An aura can show here and in Aura Icons, Aura Bars or Groups too: the menu says where else it shows, with links
- Bar or Text (a line of words that color in), your own text (or none) and text color per minibar, UPPERCASE, name / duration / stacks text like Groups - Bars (the time in its own size, a Low Color under N seconds), a name that gives way to the time while active, a Static or Duration fill (the shortest aura or one you pick, for the whole bar or per minibar)
- Glow the bar when all are active or when one is missing (in combat only if you want), Glow While Active per minibar
- A bar belongs to its class (Load On picks the specs), or Global with Load On any spec or class. Editing Spec shows and edits any spec's bars
- Standalone with its own mover (Inherit Width from Anchor) or in Bar Setup, Visibility, exports and Profile Sync
- Works on secret auras in combat. All / None and the glow need the aura in Blizzard's Cooldown Manager: the menu names the ones missing and opens Cooldown Settings
### New: Groups - Text
- Auras and cooldowns as lines of text: [name] [cd] [stacks], with anything you like around them
- Auras work like Groups - Bars (Spec/Class/Global, Aura Collections, Blizzard filters, sorting, Visibility). A cooldown line shows while the spell is on cooldown (not the GCD), then hides, stays or shows a Ready Text. An aura line can stay or show a Missing Text while the aura is down
- One group serves every class: a character gets its spec, class and Global lines for spells it knows. Max Lines fills cooldowns first
- Own colors per part (the time can turn a Low Color under N seconds), left/right/center alignment that doesn't wobble, UPPERCASE option
### New: Kick Tracker
- Your group's interrupts as bars (off by default). In keys it reads Blizzard's meter, so a cooldown only starts when that member's interrupt count went up
- Cooldowns from class, spec and talents (inspected before the key). Healers without a kick get no row, warlocks follow their demon
- Colors tab customization: name, bar, background and time each get a color per state (Ready, On Cooldown, Almost Ready) or the class color. Almost Ready is the last few seconds before a kick is back, and can glow too.
- The usual look and anchor options, the time in its own size, Visibility (dungeons to start), exports and Profile Sync. Off means nothing runs; /tui kick shows what it knows
### New: Raid Frame Builder
- Sorts ElvUI's raid frames by your own name list, everyone else by name. Open Builder (/tui rf): drag frames, Sort by Role, Stack Classes, Save
- Layouts are account-wide, Enable is per profile. Export/Import shared with things for EUI
- Changes wait for combat to end, and nobody is ever left out
### Character Setup (/tui alt)
- New window like the things for EUI installer: a row per addon (Install / Reinstall / Update / Load), Profile... and 1440p / 1080p
- ElvUI and BigWigs switch per spec on classes with a healer or Aug spec: FHT there, NHT on the rest
- New: BigWigs (NHT + FHT) and Blizzard CDM layouts per spec from the things for EUI pack, also in the installer
- New: Platynator profile import.
- The login popup lists what it loads and the CDM layouts you're missing (Everything / Everything but CDM / Skip), and no longer blocks keybinds
- Pack updates: you're told at login when the NHT/FHT pack changes. Review shows only what changed, with your own edits unticked (/tui updates)
- Old presets, Multi-Spec role profiles and per-spec Edit Mode switching are gone
### Profile Sync
- New Sync tab: tick profiles to keep in step and pick modules (All, or Some: single groups, Aura Icons per spec, styles, CDM parts). X/Y and W/H stay per profile unless ticked
- Pushes on profile switch, logout or Sync Now; Take It From... pulls first. Groups match by name and ask on differences; Aura Icons/Bars and Aura Collections follow along
- A reset, imported or outside-copied profile leaves the sync. Green S on synced modules, exports carry the setup, installer page
- Copy modules or single items between profiles: Import - Export - Install > Profiles (and ElvUI's Module Copy)
- Damage Meter and Minimap are exported now
### CDM & Spell Editor
- Spell Editor has its own Modules entry, its settings in tabs (Show, Look, Glow, Text, Aura On Top), and lists only this spec's spells (plus ones you dragged between categories)
- Spells the CDM doesn't list (Wrath) sit at the bottom of the list, or type a Spell ID. Show In puts one in Essential or Utility at the position you pick
- When You Can't Cast It per spell: Not Enough Power / Not Usable with Desaturate, Tint and Alpha, wherever the spell shows (CDM icons, the spells above, Groups - Icons, Timers, racials). Out-of-range red still wins
- Show per spell: Visibility rules or Only On Cooldown / Only When Ready take it out of the row (and out of Groups - Icons)
- Aura Icon On Top: an Aura Icon covers a cooldown while its aura is up (Garrote's DoT over Garrote, or any other aura), with optional Spell Cooldown On Top while it covers it
- Per spell: Aura Overlay, swipe direction and color, Recharge Swipe, Pandemic Glow and own glow style. Per buff: glow and Invert Swipe
- New Layout > Aura Overlay: Hide Aura Overlay, aura swipe color and direction, Pandemic Glow (Blizzard / Hidden / Custom)
- Charge spells show the full swipe while a charge recharges (off in Settings or per spell)
- Cooldown Settings stays closed once you close it; an overflowed icon takes its new row's text
### Aura Icons & Aura Bars
- Aura Icons measure like CDM icons (size, zoom, border outside), existing ones keep their look
- Show: While Active, Always (idle greyed) or Only When Missing, in groups too: Always keeps a fixed slot there and the aura draws on it. Only When Missing works in combat through the CDM
- When You Can't Cast It for the spell behind the aura (in a row, or on Always / Only When Missing)
- Aura Type reads Auto, no more empty Icon/Bar 1-3 slots, and an aura you talented out of goes away (rows and Bar Setup close up)
- Frame Level next to Frame Strata, Custom Icon, sample text in the previews
- Pixel Glow's Bordered Stroke works without Show Border: a stroke only while it glows (Groups too)
- Aura Bars, Totem / No Aura Timer: While Missing a Buff (Timer & Ticks tab) changes the bar's color and/or its text, in combat too (a Death and Decay bar that turns red when you step out of it)
- Aura Bars: Fill By Stacks (Groups - Bars too), list split like Aura Icons', Move Up / Down in Bar Setup per spec
- Aura Bars: Show In > Bar Setup works on any bar. Other specs' bar with the same number stays Standalone, and Bar Order says why a bar sits out
- Position in Row is the icon's real place in Essential/Utility (1, 2, 3 = the first three)
- Duration: Color When Low (a color under N seconds, secret auras too) and, on Aura Bars, its own Font Size. Groups - Bars got both
### Groups
- Add Buff lists your spec's Cooldown Manager buffs (on Class: every spec's), then the common ones
- Borders sit inside the icon like WeakAuras and Spacing shows the real gap (your groups look the same). The group's border covers everything in

# Changelog

## 4.2.0
- Special Icons and Special Bars renamed to **Aura Icons** and **Aura Bars**, makes more sense or something maybe idno.
### CDM
- New: Aura Icons can sit inside the Essential or Utility row, like EUI's buffs in Essentials. Pick "Show In" → Essential/Utility Cooldowns and set "Position in Row", or use Add Aura Icon in CDM → Layout → Essential/Utility. They use the row's duration and stack text unless you tick Override CDM Row Text
- New: no more doubles in CDM. Spells, trinkets and racials you put in a Group, the spell your Charge Bar tracks, and auras you show as Aura Icons/Bars or group auras, are hidden from Blizzard's rows (toggle in CDM → Settings)
- New: CDM → Spell Editor, glow (on proc / always / never, own color), cooldown text and stacks/charges (hide, size, color, position) for one spell at a time. Aura Icons you put in a row show up in its list too, with a button to their settings. Two tabs: Cooldowns (Essential/Utility) and Buff Icons (duration text and stacks per buff, kept apart from the cooldown of the same spell). Buffs an Aura Icon or Aura Bar already shows are pink there, with a button to their settings. X/Y offsets work without picking a point too
- CDM options split up: Layout (Essential, Utility, Buff Icons, Glow), Spell Editor, Racials, Trinkets, Cluster Positioning, Settings
- New: on-use trinkets can go straight into Essential or Utility (CDM → Trinkets → Destination), no need to drag them in Blizzard's Cooldown Settings. Blizzard's own copy hides itself
- Trinkets: Hide Cooldown now hides the trinket everywhere, also from its Destination row or group
- Fixed CDM stack and charge text drawing bigger than the same font size elsewhere: ElvUI's skin made it skip the icon's (and the UI's) scale. It follows its icon again like the cooldown text, so those texts get smaller and you may want to raise their size
- The options preview (thingsUI CDM/Groups/Aura pages or Cooldown Settings open) shows sample cooldown and stack/charge text on CDM icons in their real style, Spell Editor tweaks included, and spells with an Always glow or an own glow color glow in it
- Racials put in a Group no longer show in CDM as well
- Auto-enable Cooldown Manager now turns the Cooldown Manager back on whenever it is off (it only did this once per character). With it unticked, thingsUI says in chat once why the CDM rows are empty
- CDM rows keep their thingsUI layout in Edit Mode instead of falling apart (while "Lock CDM viewers in /editmode" is on, the default)
- Cluster Positioning: unit frames keep the same gap whether Essential or Utility is the wider row (they moved closer going from 5 to 6 essentials)
### Aura Collections
- New module: Aura Collections, named aura lists for Groups - Icons and Groups - Bars. Edit a collection once and every group using it follows
- A collection is a spell list or Blizzard filters (Big Defensives, External Defensives, Important, HoTs and Shields, Crowd Control; tick several to show auras matching any of them), and can pull in the spells of an ElvUI filter. A Blizzard filter needs no list: the game decides what counts
- New built-in: Defensives (Blizzard's BIG_DEFENSIVE filter). The old Ready-Made Sets are collections now, and sets you already added follow them. Every collection can be renamed, built-ins too (clear the name to get the original back)
- Blizzard's Buff Icons copy of an aura a filter group shows hides too (with the duplicates toggle)
- Opening Blizzard's Cooldown Settings also previews Groups and Aura Icons/Bars, like their options pages do. Their options pages open Cooldown Settings too (and close it again if they opened it), like CDM and Buff Bars already did
### Visibility
- New Visibility tab on Aura Icons, Aura Bars and Groups - Bars, and a much bigger one on Groups - Icons: Show (Always / In Combat / Out of Combat / Never), Solo / Party / Raid, Only In (Open World, Dungeon, Raid, Delve, Scenario, Arena, Battleground, Housing), Only in Form (your class's forms, like Cat / Bear / Moonkin, or No Form) and Hide When (Mounted, No Target, No Enemy Target, Resting). Every rule you set has to match; ticked boxes in one list are alternatives
- Aura Icons and Bars inside a group follow the group's rules; the options pages keep showing everything as a preview
### Aura Icons & Bars
- New: Aura Type on Aura Icons, Buff or Debuff (both, as before) / Buff (on you) / Debuff (on target). Fixes an icon like Fiery Brand showing twice in a group: it is a debuff on the target and an aura on you
- Groups: Add Aura Icon / Add Aura Bar is one list now. A spell that already has an icon or bar moves into the group, any other spell gets a new one. The list says where each one sits today (group, Essential/Utility, standalone)
- Aura Icons: the side list has its own Essential Cooldowns / Utility Cooldowns headings
- Aura Bars: Copy Bar, like Copy Icon on Aura Icons
- Reverse Fill for Aura Bars, Groups - Bars and Buff Bars (totem ticks follow it)
- Fixed Edit Bar in Groups - Bars, and right-clicking an Aura Bar/Icon mover, opening the module page instead of that bar or icon
- Groups - Icons with a sorted Aura Order can pick one Style for all their auras (Order tab). Sorting puts every aura in one shared list, so per-entry styles can't apply there; their style selects grey out instead of silently doing nothing
- Aura Bars and Groups - Bars: color for name, duration and stacks text
- Groups - Bars: stacks got their own outline, like Aura Bars
### Groups
- Fixed Concentrated Silvermoon Health Potion and silver Alluring Nostrum getting the Fleeting border (they have no Fleeting version)
- Potion of Zealotry (and its Fleeting versions) is a known potion now: ranks group together and Common Items lists it
### Movers & frames
- Picking a new Anchor Frame anywhere (Aura Bars/Icons, Groups, Buff Bars, CDM rows, Charge Bar, Timers, Bar Setup, focus frame) resets the points to CENTER/CENTER and the offsets to 0, instead of keeping numbers meant for the old frame
- Fixed nudging thingsUI movers (mouse wheel / nudge window): Essentials jumped, locked movers could be nudged, and Aura Bars/Icons, Groups and Timers saved a weird anchor
- Fixed a new Groups - Icons group (or a standalone Timer) snapping back to the middle in /emove until a reload, after switching profiles: its mover still belonged to the other profile's group with the same number. Mover names follow group renames too
- New: Group Frame Anchor (ElvUI QoL), keeps party/raid frames on one corner of their mover so they grow away from it, also near the screen edge
- New: Action Bar 2 and 13 (ElvUI QoL). Bar 13 is the bar Blizzard and EllesmereUI call Action Bar 6, so coming from EUI your spells sit there. Preview both, copy one onto the other (the source stays), move keybinds over. Optional: keybinds follow the bar your profile shows, and the shown bar fills itself on each spec when it's empty
### Installer
- Turns on Chat → Voice Chat → Hide Voice Buttons
- Quick setups and Alt Profiles also set your healer/dps spec profiles (FHT/NHT) from the role presets
### Commands
- Everything lives under /tui now: `/tui` opens the options, `/tui install` the installer, `/tui alt` the alt profile setup, `/tui prof` the profiler.
### Performance
- Performance: Hide Aura Overlay runs one full pass per cooldown update instead of three (plus the nested ones it triggered on itself)
- Performance: Buff Bars only re-lay bars that actually changed, and stop re-setting strata and anchor on every aura update
- Performance: CDM layout passes no longer re-anchor proxies that are already in place (that woke cluster positioning every time)
- CDM modules share one Blizzard hook per viewer instead of five separate ones on Essential
- CDM text follows ElvUI's Cooldown Manager text options again on newer ElvUI versions
- New /tui prof: thingsUI load time, plus thingsUI, ElvUI and ElvUI_Libraries CPU from Blizzard's addon profiler
### Class Stuff
- DH: Charged Bars spell swap (Veng: IS -> F
